mapper.select: SELECT baseline_hash,baseline_json,repair_hash FROM task_fixed_workflow_runs WHERE task_id=#{args[0]}
SELECT stage,input_hash,output_hash,output_json,status FROM task_fixed_workflow_nodes WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND node_id=#{args[1]}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_fixed_workflow_nodes SET output_hash=#{args[0]},output_json=#{args[1]},status='COMPLETED',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{args[2]} AND node_id=#{args[3]} AND input_hash=#{args[4]} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE task_step_progress SET status='SUCCEEDED',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),error_code=NULL WHERE task_id=#{args[0]} AND step_id=#{args[1]} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
UPDATE task_fixed_workflow_runs SET repair_hash=#{args[0]} WHERE task_id=#{args[1]} AND repair_hash IS NULL
